line: Smile first, before anyone else does.
paragraph: Laura O'Brien, a 24-year-old in England, had just asked for a sign when a kingfisher streaked toward her. The small Eurasian Kingfisher landed on her hand and stayed there for ten minutes. She told SWNS news she was amazed. Sometimes the world answers before we finish hoping.
